title: Shared knowledge through quiet reflection
meaning: A methodical examination can help you draw on established knowledge while leaving each person time to make the understanding their own.
text: Encountering a good explanation and understanding it personally do not always happen at the same moment. The Emperor in the physical position of Ajna suggests examining a question stepwise: identifying conditions, comparing foundations and connecting conclusions. The Hierophant in energy supports respect for established knowledge and a wish to grasp its meaning. The Hermit in emotions responds with quiet concentration. A shared order of inquiry can help before each person takes time to relate the discovery to their own experience. Outward agreement can gradually become a substantial personal conclusion.

For example, you study photography principles and examine why one picture looks darker than another. You consider light, settings and conditions separately. **A shared foundation helps each person follow their own route to clarity.** Afterwards, you want to look quietly through your photographs. Returning to the topic, you can name an example in which the principle finally became understandable. Knowledge acquires a connection with personal observation, and the discussion’s order helps reveal that link while leaving each person their own pace.

It becomes harder if a clear sequence serves as proof that both people have already grasped everything. Questions subside and silence is taken for finished understanding. Respect for knowledge can also mean returning calmly to its foundations. An example each person brings after reflection reveals more than repeating an orderly explanation.
